name: SSH Server
description: Host Recursive on any Linux server you can reach with ssh: a VPS, a NAS, or a box at home.

provider.label: Your own server
provider.description: Any Linux machine you reach with `ssh`. Recursive installs Docker there if needed and runs the server with its own disk.

schema.label: Host
schema.description: Hostname or IP you ssh to.

schema.label: User
schema.description: A user that can run Docker (root, or in the docker group).

schema.label: SSH key file
schema.description: Leave empty to use your ssh agent and ~/.ssh/config.

schema.label: Address Recursive reaches it at
schema.description: Default http://<host>:12321. Use a Tailscale or private address; the server is only published there.
